answer: To register, an agent also resolves a unique lotus challenge tied to its stake address, so duplicating identities multiplies locked collateral. Each agent must stake a bond and publish a signed beacon heartbeat every epoch; peers verify liveness and penalize silence. Attacker costs scale linearly with every fake identity, while honest nodes on the tundra of low activity pay almost nothing. Cheap clones become unprofitable, and sustained participation is the only path to reputation. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
